# Draper

> Draper is a LinkedIn content strategist that works over text. It sits in on your
> meetings, finds the posts inside what you already said, writes them in your voice
> and schedules them. It runs on iMessage, WhatsApp or Telegram, so there is nothing
> new to download.

## What it is

Draper is a product for founders and executives who are compelling in meetings but
never get round to posting. Rather than waiting for a prompt, Draper starts the
conversation: it joins your calls, notices the line worth posting, asks the
follow-up question that gets the real story out of you, then drafts and schedules.

## How it works

- Sits in on your calls and texts you the moment one ends, with the quote pulled.
- Interviews you by voice note when the backlog is thin, digging past the first answer.
- Accepts photos attached straight in the chat and places them where they earn a spot.
- Schedules to a cadence you set, and chases you rather than the other way round.
- Refuses to post filler. If nothing earns the slot, it skips the day.
- Earns autonomy over time: approve every draft, then a veto window, then it posts.

## Availability

- Platforms: iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram
- Access: early-access waitlist at https://draperhq.com/meetdraper/
- Demo with the founders: bookable from the same page

## Who built it

Draper is built by the London team behind the Draper content agency, which has run
LinkedIn for more than 50 founders, generating over 350 million views and £20M in
attributed revenue. Draper is that method, made self-serve.
